hero.title: WordPress Performance & Optimization
hero.subtitle: A slow site loses visits, conversions, and ranking. I optimize your WordPress for fast loading, stability, and a better user experience.

items.title: Slow Site Loading
items.description: High response times that affect user experience, increase bounce rates, and hurt search engine rankings.

items.title: Unoptimized Images
items.description: Files that are too heavy, uncompressed, or lack modern formats (WebP/AVIF), slowing down mobile and slow connection loads.

items.title: Excessive Plugins
items.description: Unnecessary, duplicate, or poorly developed extensions that consume server resources and generate internal conflicts.

items.title: Bloated Database
items.description: Accumulated revisions, expired transients, orphaned tables, and unnecessary records that increase queries and reduce site speed.

items.title: Poorly Configured Hosting
items.description: Servers without active caching systems, old PHP versions, low memory limits, or low-performance shared infrastructure.

items.title: Lack of Caching System
items.description: Absence of page cache, CSS/JS file minification, or lazy loading, forcing the server to generate every page from scratch.

tech.title: Technical Site Optimization
tech.description: Optimization goes far beyond installing a plugin. I analyze the entire site and apply real technical improvements.

items.title: Structural Resource Optimization
items.description: Reorganization of images, scripts, and styles to improve loading times.

items.title: Multi-level Caching
items.description: Coordinated configuration between server and application to reduce unnecessary load.

items.title: Database Debugging
items.description: Optimization of tables, queries, and indexes to improve internal performance.

items.title: Dependency Audit
items.description: Evaluation of the real impact of plugins and external resources.

items.title: Performance Architecture
items.description: Design oriented to minimize blocks and prioritize critical resources.

items.title: Server Optimization
items.description: I reduce TTFB and latency through advanced server configuration.

items.title: Optimized Rendering
items.description: I prioritize visible content by optimizing the critical rendering path.

items.title: Visual Stability
items.description: I eliminate layout shifts (CLS) and interaction delays (FID).

access.title: Website Access
access.p1: To perform a real optimization, access to the WordPress panel and hosting is required.
